dst.text: Kaldra is a guardian that can be summoned from pieces, as Drooge, the new Troll Leader, reveals, with the last piece held in the Vault of Whispers. Glissa emerges in the arm of the Kaldra Champion, slaughtering many vedalken and then destroying every leveler and weapon in rage as Al-Hayat dies.

Glissa takes out one of Memnarch's legs, but Memnarch casts his trademark spell and seizes control of Kaldra, and Bosh steps in front of his friends and is dispatched in seconds. When the fifth sun dawns, the Kaldra avatar evaporates and the Tangle is devastated.
